x.author: LawMind3246
x.body:
5. 🔍 Why Is Certification Important?
If a company states
> **“Our fuel is Green Methanol.”**
The next question from a Legal / ESG perspective should be
> **Green because of what?**
We should be able to answer:
• Where does the feedstock come from?
• What energy source is used in production?
• Where does the CO₂ come from?
• Where does the hydrogen come from?
• Where was the fuel produced?
• Who certified it?
• Is there a Chain of Custody?
• Can the fuel be traced back to its source?
• What is it
